system.description: • Effect: If your deity is a war god (Torm, Helm, Tyr, Drake, Moradin, Gruumsh, Maglubiyet, Bane, Zindel of Mournas or Daeric Khyrmin), you can become a Battle Priest when you take your first Cleric level. The choice is permanent. You use the Knight Base to Hit track (the Paladin's: +7 at 12th, +15 at 24th) instead of the Cleric's, you gain Extra Attack at 7th level, and your spell slots come from the Spells Per Day row two below your Cleric level (none at 1st or 2nd level). Cantrips, Turn Undead and your deity's granted power are unchanged. A Battle Priest needs 12 XP per level, like the Paladin, instead of the Cleric's 10.
